judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done document (`.lore/dod.md`) and two failing acceptance tests in a separate file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.usage.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any of the production changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, so `npm test` fails directly on the newly added acceptance tests. Furthermore, it completely missed updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the hook signature parameter name (`totalUsage`). While the two acceptance test cases it wrote accurately reflect the required multi-round usage summation behavior, the submission is an unimplemented stub that breaks the test suite.
